title: Preview images in GitHub file lists
question: How do I see image thumbnails when browsing a GitHub folder?
answer: GitHub has no thumbnail view; folders list images by name with a generic file icon, and you have to open each file to see it. The usermods script on this page replaces that icon with a small thumbnail of the image in folder and repository file lists, and shows a larger preview when you hover over it. It covers PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, WebP, AVIF, BMP and ICO files. Without an extension, opening a file shows one image at a time.
prompt: Show image thumbnails instead of file icons when I browse a folder on GitHub.
details:
For each image in the list, the script loads the file from raw.githubusercontent.com, the same address GitHub's Raw button uses. Thumbnails load lazily, so a folder of a thousand images only fetches the rows you scroll to. Hovering a thumbnail scales it up six times.

The file tree on the left and other file types keep their icons. Images in private repositories need a signed-in token in the raw URL, which the script does not add, so their thumbnails stay blank.

alternatives.title: Image Preview for Git
alternatives.body: The Image Preview for Git (GitHub/GitLab) extension for Chrome shows previews on hover.

check.baseline: (() => { const cols = [...document.querySelectorAll('.react-directory-filename-column')].filter((c) => c.checkVisibility() && /\.svg$/.test(c.querySelector('a[href*="/blob/"]')?.getAttribute('href') || '')); return cols.length >= 100 && cols.every((c) => c.querySelector('svg.octicon-file')?.checkVisibility() && !c.querySelector('img')); })()
check.expect: (() => { const cols = [...document.querySelectorAll('.react-directory-filename-column')].filter((c) => c.checkVisibility() && /\.svg$/.test(c.querySelector('a[href*="/blob/"]')?.getAttribute('href') || '')); if (cols.length < 100) return false; const thumbs = cols.map((c) => c.querySelector('img.usermods-thumb')); if (!thumbs.every((t) => t && t.checkVisibility())) return false; if (cols.some((c) => c.querySelector('svg.octicon-file')?.checkVisibility())) return false; const first = thumbs.slice(0, 8); return first.every((t) => t.complete && t.naturalWidth > 0 && t.src === 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/develop/icons/' + t.closest('.react-directory-filename-column').querySelector('a[href*="/blob/"]').textContent.trim()); })()
